description: Automated dependency updates for the arch-canvas monorepo. Every pull request Renovate opens is an ordinary pull request, so .github/workflows/ci.yaml runs the full suite on it: lint, commit-lint, typecheck, unit, integration, e2e, the compose smoke boot, the capability audit and the image builds. Nothing merges without that.

packageRules.description: Ecosystems are updated as one pull request each, never one per dependency. Restricted to minor/patch on purpose: the major rule at the bottom of this list ungroups anything that could break a build so it can be reviewed on its own.

Node stays on 22.x (root package.json engines, .nvmrc, and the node:22 images the Dockerfiles build from). Node 24 breaks apps/server's callProvider tests: AbortSignal stops working across realms under jsdom. Raising this ceiling is a deliberate migration, not a dependency bump.
Majors are never grouped. Each one gets its own pull request so a red build points at a single dependency, and each waits for approval on the dependency dashboard.
